name: sankathara-chaturthi
description: Tests and checks for the Sankathara Chaturthi site. The site itself has no build step: the files at the repository root are served as they are. Run everything from this folder (cd tests).

scripts.full: npm run lint && npm run types && npm run unit && playwright test
scripts.lint: stylelint --config stylelint.config.mjs "../css/**/*.css" && cd .. && eslint -c tests/eslint.config.mjs js sw.js
